claims.text: FutureBuilder builds with a snapshot in ConnectionState.waiting while the future is incomplete and again once it completes (the sequence is timing-dependent; the builder may be called more times); the snapshot exposes connectionState, hasError/error and data.
_ProductListScreenState assigns _products = widget.apiClient.fetchProducts() in initState, and the FutureBuilder uses future: _products.

The builder returns a centred CircularProgressIndicator while waiting, Text('Could not load products: ${snapshot.error}') on error, Text('No products yet.') when the list is empty, and otherwise the list; snapshot.data ?? [] treats missing data as empty.
Creating the future in initState (not in build) means rebuilds pass the same future and do not start new requests; the FutureBuilder docs warn against creating the future during build.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: FutureBuilder ('The future must have been obtained earlier, e.g. during State.initState')

claims.text: fetchProducts' Future fails when the status is not 200 or when Product.fromJson cannot read a field, and FutureBuilder reports both as hasError.

With the api container stopped, the browser request from the app (origin :8081) to Caddy (:8080) fails (Caddy's 502 carries no CORS header), http's BrowserClient throws a ClientException ("Failed to fetch"), and the screen shows "Could not load products: ClientException: …".
claims.source_hint: reviewer r1: curl (502 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin) + headless Chrome fetch (TypeError: Failed to fetch); http 1.6.0 browser_client.dart

claims.text: `docker compose stop api` / `docker compose start api` stop and start the api service of the lab; browser developer tools can slow the connection down on purpose from the Network tab.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: docker compose stop/start; Chrome DevTools network throttling

claims.text: Loading, error and empty mean different things to a user and need different UI.
While the future is waiting (with no initialData) or after it fails, snapshot.data is null.
claims.source_hint: Flutter SDK widgets/async.dart (AsyncSnapshot.waiting / withError carry no data)
